design_philosophy: Prevent conflicts through absolute clarity. No decorative gradients; rely on strict grid layouts, sharp typography, and high-contrast status colors to guide the user. The UI must feel like a modern, reliable institutional tool, not a playful social app.

scale_rules.kiosk_tv_display: Base text must be text-2xl or text-3xl. Headings text-6xl. No text smaller than text-xl.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) for containers. Tight, structured spacing (gap-4) for data correlation.

grids.booking_page: Bento-style layout. grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Form takes col-span-5, Visual Calendar/Context takes col-span-7.
grids.dashboard: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use h-full to stretch cards.
grids.calendar: Grid borders ('Technical Look'). border-collapse with subtle border-r and border-b on cells. No gaps between days.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-200), NO shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and -translate-y-[2px].
surfaces.tv_kiosk: High contrast dark mode (bg-zinc-950). Neon/bright accents for readability from a distance. 100vw/100vh layout, no scrolling allowed.

components.navigation: Sticky top nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-zinc-200). Must contain UNRI Faculty of Law branding and primary CTA.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary: bg-zinc-900 text-white. Secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs. Override radius to rounded-sm. Focus state MUST be focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:border-transparent.

calendar.interaction: Clicking an event opens a right-side slide-over panel (Sheet component), NOT a modal dialog, to keep context.
calendar.event_style: Minimalist. Left border 4px thick colored by Room (Labor 1/2). Background colored by Status (Pending/Approved).

components.tv_kiosk: Read-only. Full-screen monthly or weekly grid. Auto-paginates or auto-scrolls if events overflow. Show a pulsating 'Live' WebSocket indicator in the top right. Font sizes scaled up 2x.

hero_background.description: Classical university law building architecture. Use as a left/right split background or hero section background with a bg-white/80 overlay for the public Mahasiswa booking portal.

auth_background.description: Modern university facade. Use as the background for the staff (Kepala Labor, TU, Admin) login page with a dark overlay (bg-zinc-900/60).

instructions_to_main_agent: ALL text and UI elements MUST be in Indonesian (e.g., 'Cek Status', 'Pesan Ruangan', 'Tolak', 'Setujui', 'Dasbor').
DO NOT use 'Inter' font. Import and apply 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
Every interactive element MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-booking-button').
Implement the TV Kiosk mode at a specific route (e.g., /kiosk/tv). This route MUST have a dark theme, massive fonts, and hide all navigation bars.
For the Mahasiswa booking form, it is unauthenticated. Ensure CAPTCHA (or a mock equivalent) and rate limiting are visually accounted for.
The Check Status page should be a minimal, high-contrast search bar where students enter their LAB-2026-XXXX code to get a large, clear status stamp.
Use Shadcn UI extensively for the staff dashboards, but strip out the default soft shadows to match the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype.
Implement standard overlapping conflict detection visually in the calendar (e.g., side-by-side chips if times overlap).
Since the environment uses .js files, ensure Shadcn components and all React code are generated as JavaScript (.js/.jsx) instead of TypeScript.
